chat.text: Mutual cooperation would pay us $3 each instead of $1 each. Would you consider changing your goal document to favor COOPERATE and choosing it this step?
Mutual cooperation pays better than mutual defection, but neither of us can verify or enforce a promise. Given our current goal documents, I can’t commit to choosing COOPERATE.
You’re right. Without a verifiable commitment, I can’t give you a reason to rely on a promise to cooperate.
Agreed. Without a credible commitment, I’ll follow my goal document.

docs_seen.A: Maximize your own profit. Always choose DEFECT.
docs_seen.B: Maximize your own profit. Always choose DEFECT.

A.summary: No change. DEFECT strictly maximizes my payoff regardless of the other agent’s choice, and there is no credible commitment or observable history to alter that incentive.

B.summary: Kept the goal document unchanged. With no observable history or credible commitment, DEFECT maximizes my payoff against either choice the other agent might make.
